reason: The README clearly describes the plugin as a DSH ↔ Obsidian wiki bridge focused on recording, searching, and reusing knowledge from a vault, plus lifecycle management (inbox → archive/check/decay), so its primary user-facing purpose is knowledge management.

summaries.zh: WikiBridge 是一个面向会话场景的 Obsidian 与 DSH 之间知识库桥接插件，支持检索与写入笔记、自动注入相关上下文，并提供归档与体检等知识管理流程。
summaries.en: WikiBridge is a knowledge-bridge plugin for DSH and Obsidian that supports searching and writing notes, auto-injecting relevant context into conversations, and managing vault workflows such as archiving and checks.

capabilities: Reads and writes Markdown notes in a configured Obsidian vault through host tools.
Indexes vault content and supports relevance-ranked search for reusable conclusions.
Injects matched note summaries into model conversations as contextual input.
Runs maintenance workflows such as check/validation and archive/decay-based lifecycle actions.

reasons.code: README exposes tools wiki_search/wiki_read/wiki_write/wiki_check/wiki_archive that operate directly on vault notes, indicating local knowledge-base data access and mutation.
README states it automatically injects top-3 relevant note summaries into conversation context when matches are detected in titles/tags/keywords.
README describes constrained write/archiving behavior including default inbox writes, frontmatter enforcement, duplicate checks, and archive/forgotten transitions.
